description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a dashboard screen, including UI layout, header, featured card, quick actions, curated carousel, and bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the dashboard screen with state management for selected tab.

classes.name: _DashboardScreenState
classes.description: State class managing UI state for DashboardScreen, including tab selection and widget build.

classes.name: _Header
classes.description: Stateless widget rendering the welcome header with greeting and action icons.

classes.name: _TopIconButton
classes.description: Reusable widget for icon buttons in the header with tooltip support.

classes.name: _FeaturedCard
classes.description: Displays a gradient-backed promotional card with title, subtitle, and CTA pill.

classes.name: _PillButton
classes.description: Styled button widget resembling a pill for call-to-action interactions.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Renders a styled section title text.

classes.name: _QuickActionsRow
classes.description: Arranged row of quick action tiles.

classes.name: _QuickActionTile
classes.description: Individual quick action tile with icon and label.

classes.name: _CuratedCarousel
classes.description: Horizontal list of curated content cards with gradients.

classes.name: _CuratedCard
classes.description: Individual curated content card with title, gradient background, and add button.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Custom bottom navigation bar with icons and selection handling.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the DashboardScreen widget.
